title: Kenyan Smoky Hash
description: A hearty breakfast dish from Kenya, this smoky hash is made with sweet potatoes and a blend of spices.
instructions: Toss the diced sweet potatoes with olive oil, smoky hash, and paprika until they are evenly coated.
Spread the sweet potatoes on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
Crumble the saltines and sprinkle over the sweet potatoes, if using.
Return the sweet potatoes to the oven for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the saltines are toasted.
Serve the Kenyan smoky hash hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
